clock_controls.scope: Injected 30-second close in child.cancel test port; tests only. No production code mutation.

limitations: All selected runnable suites passed on Linux with controlled filesystem and loopback fixtures; no native OS or live provider/SSH run was performed.
Fixtures have zero independent cases; all four known capture-loader consumer suites were additionally run.
Clock counterexamples inject a 30-second close at the controlled child.cancel port; this is a test-port defect demonstration, not production code mutation.
